activity.notes: After conquering Naples in 1442, Alfonso V of Aragon ruled there as Alfonso I until his death in 1458. The different regnal numeral reflects the Neapolitan crown and does not indicate a second person.

sources.title: Alan Ryder, Alfonso the Magnanimous: King of Aragon, Naples, and Sicily 1396–1458
sources.citation_text: Oxford University Press's scholarly biography follows Alfonso V from accession to the Aragonese throne in 1416 through his conquest of Naples in 1442 and rule until 1458.

review_context.correction_note: Add the concurrent Neapolitan crown to the same Alfonso V person.
